Exhaustive coding assessments
Using the power of online compilers and validated
test cases, auto-assess the skills related to backend
programming, database programming, data science
programming, frontend programming, scripting,
and more. Design the tests for screenings, capability
assessments, or hackathons based on your needs.
Live coding interviews:
Rise to the challenge
Host interactive coding sessions with candidates to
accurately assess their technical skills in an unbiased
manner. Choose coding questions from our library or
have a brainstorming session over a shared coding
window. Our platform supports over 38 programming
languages.
Learn more about
Video Interviews
Boldly assess talent
in 38 programming languages
Evaluate coding talent with our extensive library covering
thousands of questions across 38 programming languages.
Our platform supports Bash, C, C++, C#, D, Erlang, F#,
GNU Octave, Go, Java 7, Java 8, JavaScript, jQuery, Node.js, Perl,
PHP, Python 2, Python 3, R, Ruby, Rust, Scala, MySQL, HTML,
CSS, Angular, AngularJS, and Data Science (Python).
High-quality insights like never before
Get detailed insights for each test taker with stack rank
(rank, percentile, marks), code status (compilation
status, test case status, time to solve), code performance
(average memory consumption, average
execution time), code quality (cyclomatic complexity,
lines of code, plagiarism score).
Unwavering tech that enables
advanced automated proctoring
Built by a team of experts with more than 20 patents, HirePro
Coding Assessments comes with automated detection and
control of cheating. It lets you automatically notice fraudulent
behavior through AI-powered impersonation and multiple
people detection, plagiarism report, and code playback.
You can control fraudulent behavior through AI-powered live
proctoring, automated warnings and disqualification, question
randomisation and auto-expiration, secure browser, and
granular access control with time, IP, and browser.
Online Proctoring
Boost candidate confidence
with superior experience
You are assured of creating a superior candidate
experience with our intuitive interface with a feature-rich
coding editor. The platform eliminates retests by gracefully
recovering from machine and internet issues. Automatic
emails and SMS triggers ensure continued candidate
engagement. Our platform also provides the capability to
offer candidate support via phone, chat, and email.
Automation that makes
test administrators fearless
We understand the workflow of test administrators and our
platform automates them. With our assessments, you can
manage test validity automatically, digitise candidate
registration, and automate eligibility checks, which can be
customised to any specific assessment need.
You can configure candidate emails and SMSes for better
engagement, create multiple tiers of tests with automatic
shortlisting, and evaluate test results automatically.
Our platform also offers automatic data sync with your ATS and
customisable reports for your review.
Trust by design. Ethical. Secure. Compliant.
Ethical AI, security, privacy, and compliance are not afterthoughts. They are the foundational principles at HirePro. Built from the ground up on enterprise-grade infrastructure, the platform is engineered to meet the rigorous standards of ISO 27001, GDPR, and DPDPA.
Ethical AI starts with humans in control. Every model is rigorously tested across ten facets of recruitment ethics, spanning bias detection on protected attributes, PII handling, and decision explainability. Every recommendation is transparent and open to challenge, ensuring that AI augments hiring decisions without ever quietly making them. Recruiters decide; AI assists.
Customer data is hosted on Amazon Web Services with strong access controls. Personally identifiable information is encrypted at rest and in transit. Data can be deleted or extracted as needed.
Complete audit trails are maintained for every evaluation, every recruiter action, and every system event. Your security, compliance, and audit teams get the evidence they need, when they need it.
